$comment: Registre des composants génération + publication. Chemins relatifs à apps/web/. Vérifié sur le code au 2026-05-29.

components.name: Graph builder (StateGraph)
components.responsibility: Câble START->parseBrief->enrichKnowledge->enrichTrends->generateScript, branches video/image/caption, post-compose qualityCheck->moderate->reviewGate->generateVariants->END.

components.name: Conditional routing
components.responsibility: routeAfterScript (format), routeAfterQuality (seuil 0.65, 2 retries), routeAfterModeration, routeAfterHumanReview.

components.name: Graph state
components.responsibility: ContentGenerationState : annotations LangGraph (script, images, videos, qualityScores, moderationResult, humanReview, costTracking...).

components.name: Orchestrator runGeneration/resumeGeneration
components.responsibility: Invoque engine.invoke(thread_id=jobId), détecte interruption HITL, reprise via Command({resume}), persiste job.

components.name: parseBrief node
components.responsibility: Normalise le brief d'entrée pour le graphe.

components.name: enrichKnowledge node (RAG)
components.responsibility: Recherche pgvector (searchByCollections) selon plateforme/objectif/contentType ; fallback knowledge statique + BRAND_GUIDELINES.

components.name: enrichTrends node
components.responsibility: Ajoute du contexte tendances (trends engine) à l'état.

components.name: generateScript node
components.responsibility: Génère le script (hook/scenes/cta/visualDirection) via LLM @langchain ; point de retry des gates.

components.name: generateImages node
components.responsibility: ProviderSelector (openai/higgsfield/google par priorité) sinon mock /_media/ai-engine/mock. Tailles par plateforme/format.

components.name: generateVideo node
components.responsibility: Rendu MP4 local via ffmpeg-static (drawtext par scène) ; ProviderSelector vidéo en option. Stockage .media-storage/ai-engine.

components.name: generateVoiceover node
components.responsibility: Voix-off (branche vidéo uniquement). INATTEIGNABLE depuis le create flow B.

components.name: generateMusic node
components.responsibility: Musique de fond (branche vidéo). INATTEIGNABLE depuis le create flow B.

components.name: generateSubtitles node
components.responsibility: Sous-titres (branche vidéo). INATTEIGNABLE depuis le create flow B.

components.name: generateCaption node
components.responsibility: Génère la légende + hashtags (point de convergence des branches).

components.name: compose node
components.responsibility: Compose les assets en une composition finale. INATTEIGNABLE depuis B.

components.name: transcodeExport node
components.responsibility: Transcode/exporte (ffmpeg/ffprobe) les rendus finaux. INATTEIGNABLE depuis B.

components.name: qualityCheck node
components.responsibility: Calcule des scores qualité ; gate pass/retry/fail.

components.name: moderate node
components.responsibility: Modération du contenu ; gate safe/flagged/blocked.

components.name: reviewGate (humanReview) node
components.responsibility: HITL : interrupt() si humanReviewRequired ; décision approved/approved_direct/rejected/edit_requested.

components.name: generateVariants node
components.responsibility: Produit des variantes finales avant END.

components.name: Knowledge retrieval (RAG)
components.responsibility: searchKnowledge/searchByCollections : embeddings OpenAI + requête pgvector cosine sur ai_engine_knowledge_chunk.

components.name: ProviderSelector + circuit breaker
components.responsibility: Sélection de provider par capacité/priorité, retry, circuit-breaker, cost-tracker.

components.name: Content Studio bridge (A->B)
components.responsibility: bridgeToContentStudio : matérialise un GenerationResult A en content_idea/brief/draft/generation_run (provider='ai-engine-langgraph'). Lien images mock ignoré.

components.name: POST /api/admin/ai-engine/generate
components.responsibility: Normalise body (nested|flat), runGeneration, puis bridgeToContentStudio (non bloquant). 503 si AI_ENGINE_ENABLED=false.

components.name: POST /api/admin/ai-engine/generate-stream (SSE)
components.responsibility: Streaming SSE de la progression du graphe.

components.name: POST /api/admin/ai-engine/jobs/[id]/review
components.responsibility: Décision HITL -> resumeGeneration.

components.name: AI Engine knowledge routes
components.responsibility: CRUD collections/documents, embed, seed-defaults (ingestion RAG pgvector).

components.name: POST /api/admin/ai-engine/publish
components.responsibility: Approuve un draft (issu du bridge) puis publishContentPostNow -> réutilise le pipeline de publication B.

components.name: generateIdeaDrafts
components.responsibility: Texte : generateForIdea -> brief + 3 drafts + generation_run + auto brand review + transition idea->generated.

components.name: generateVisualForDraft / generateVideoForDraft
components.responsibility: Visuel : route image|vidéo, génère, crée media + binding + generation_run, optimise (worker image) ou passthrough (vidéo).

components.name: generation.ts (generateForIdea)
components.responsibility: OpenAI chat/completions JSON (CONTENT_STUDIO_TEXT_MODEL) sinon fallback déterministe (provider='fallback').

components.name: image-generation.ts
components.responsibility: Routing modèle/mode/env : mock SVG | OpenAI gpt-image/dall-e | Higgsfield hf-*. HttpError invalid_state si clé manquante.

components.name: video-generation.ts
components.responsibility: Routing : mock MP4 statique (reel/story seulement) | Higgsfield hf-video-* (submit + poll). HttpError si live sans modèle vidéo.

components.name: higgsfield-auth.ts
components.responsibility: higgsfieldBaseUrl + higgsfieldAuthHeader (Authorization: Key KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET) ; null si credential incomplet.

components.name: brand-rules.ts (reviewDraftContent)
components.responsibility: Revue automatique charte de marque -> content_brand_review (status/score/violations).

components.name: content-studio state-machine.ts
components.responsibility: Transitions idea/draft/post (assertTransition).

components.name: postiz.ts (client HTTP)
components.responsibility: Client Postiz : integrations, upload, posts, analytics ; fetchWithRetry ; mapping payload draft.

components.name: POST /ideas/[id]/generate
components.responsibility: Déclenche generateIdeaDrafts (modèle texte optionnel).

components.name: POST /drafts/[id]/generate-visual
components.responsibility: Lit cookie cs_generation_mode (défaut mock), appelle generateVisualForDraft. maxDuration 120.

components.name: POST /posts/[id]/publish-now
components.responsibility: publishContentPostNow (idempotency header/body).

components.name: POST /posts/[id]/schedule + reschedule + cancel
components.responsibility: scheduleContentPost / reschedulePost / cancelScheduledPost.

components.name: POST /posts/[id]/postiz-draft + draft-on-provider
components.responsibility: Envoi en brouillon : createDraftInPostiz (legacy delivery) / sendContentPostToDraft (adapter).

components.name: GET /posts/[id]/publishability
components.responsibility: Pré-validation publication (statuts, média HTTPS, capabilities).

components.name: publish-jobs (list + [id] + retry + cancel)
components.responsibility: Administration des jobs : liste/détail/retry/cancel.

components.name: social-publishing admin-service.ts
components.responsibility: publishContentPostNow/schedule/sendToDraft/executeJob, resolveDefaultAccount (mode dry_run|live), sync comptes, publishability.

components.name: social-publishing service.ts
components.responsibility: publishWithAdapter : enveloppe l'appel adapter (idempotence, normalisation résultat).

components.name: publication state-machine.ts
components.responsibility: Transitions job: draft->approved->queued->publishing->published|failed; failed->queued; cancelled. nextRetryStatus, isTerminal.

components.name: worker.ts (runScheduledPublishJobs)
components.responsibility: Exécute les jobs échus (listScheduledJobsDue) via executeJob, comptabilise succeeded/failed/skipped.

components.name: social-publishing repository.ts
components.responsibility: Accès tables social_* : createPublishJob, tryAcquirePublishJobLock, recordPublishAttempt, createPublication, listScheduledJobsDue.

components.name: DryRunSocialPublishingAdapter
components.responsibility: Publication simulée : permalien social.example.test, remoteId déterministe, insights synthétiques. Aucun appel réseau.

components.name: PostizSocialPublishingAdapter
components.responsibility: Upload média + create post/draft via postiz.ts ; parse remoteId/permalink ; analytics. Publication réelle.

components.name: alerts.ts (sendSocialAlert)
components.responsibility: Webhook d'alerte sur échec de publication (hors mode draft).

components.name: cron social-publish-scheduler
components.responsibility: POST Bearer CRON_SECRET -> runScheduledPublishJobs (publie les jobs programmés échus).

components.name: cron postiz-sync
components.responsibility: Synchronise comptes/intégrations Postiz.

components.name: cron retry-deliveries
components.responsibility: Rejoue les livraisons Postiz/jobs en échec.

components.name: cron insights-ingestion
components.responsibility: Ingestion des métriques (adapter.getInsights) -> content_performance_snapshot.

components.name: cron weekly-failure-digest
components.responsibility: Digest hebdomadaire des échecs de publication.

components.name: CreateWorkspace + create UI
components.responsibility: Orchestration UI 3 colonnes : IntentionForm, MediaStudio, PreviewPane, ApproveButton, PublishActionGroup, Stepper.

components.name: GenerationModeToggle
components.responsibility: Pose le cookie cs_generation_mode (mock|live) lu par generate-visual.

components.name: ModelPicker
components.responsibility: Sélection du modèle texte/image/vidéo (mock-*, gpt-image-*, hf-*, hf-video-*).

components.name: PublishActionGroup
components.responsibility: Boutons Publier maintenant / Programmer / Brouillon sur provider ; dialogues de confirmation.

components.name: AI Engine create page
components.responsibility: Form -> POST /api/admin/ai-engine/generate (pipeline A) ; gère review HITL via jobs/[id]/review.

components.name: schema-content-studio.ts
components.responsibility: Tables content_campaign/idea/brief/draft/asset_binding/generation_run/brand_review/post/postiz_delivery/performance_snapshot/learning_note/idempotency_key.

components.name: schema-social-publishing.ts
components.responsibility: Tables social_account, social_credential, social_publish_job (idempotencyKey unique), social_publish_attempt, social_publication, social_publish_event.

components.name: schema-ai-engine.ts
components.responsibility: Tables ai_engine_workflow/provider/prompt configs, knowledge collection/document/chunk(embedding vector(1536)), generation_jobs, cost_ledger, trend_signals, api_keys.
